verdict.rationale: The evidence shows UCP-enabled storefronts automatically expose a per-merchant agent endpoint at {shop}/api/ucp/mcp and publish a business profile at /.well-known/ucp. A runtime probe confirmed a live storefront endpoint and keyless cart creation, and marketing claims merchants are discovered across AI channels with no effort. However, all the documentation is written for agent developers, not merchants, so there is no documented merchant-side path to enable, opt in, or configure agent traffic. missing for 10: merchant-facing docs for an enable setting or opt-in toggle, any agreement or terms flow, documentation of how a storefront becomes 'UCP-enabled', independent merchant hands-on corroboration.
